sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Ironclad Proof is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
"Hey there, tourist. How's life in Tarkov treating you? I figured your kind would be softer than this. Ah, never mind, let's get to business.

Everything's piling up on me at once. I'm out of grenades, and my clients are being a pain in the ass. I need your help. Show those idiots that the GP-25 underbarrel grenade launcher really gets the job done. And while you're at it, gather me some grenades. Our grenades, domestic Soviet ones."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over 10 any in raid Russian grenades to Prapor
- Eliminate any 10 targets with a GP-25 grenade launcher

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.75
- 1× Military power filter
- Unlocks purchase of Korund-VM ballistic plates (Front) at Prapor LL3
- Unlocks purchase of 23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round at Prapor LL3
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Hm... well, alright. Old offenses are forgotten, let's keep working. Just be careful around that Skier character, he's a shady dude."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
- Unlocks purchase of 40mm VOG-25 grenade at Prapor LL3
- Unlocks barter of GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Prapor LL3
